Name: Jorts and Jean SVE Compatibility Patch (Removes plank from Mountain Path)
Author: glymr
TagLine: Removes the plank that appears on the mountain path when both "Stardew Valley Expanded" and "Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats" mods are installed.
Description:
This is a very silly little mod that removes the plank that appears on the mountain path when both "Stardew Valley Expanded" and "Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats" mods are installed. Put it in your mod folder and it will auto-detect if both mods are installed and then, BOOM! PLANK-B-GONE!

Yes, it works with re-colors. I included a picture with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor installed to show that it works. ^_^

If either "Jorts and Jean" or "Stardew Valley Expanded" add a fix for this small visual issue, I'll be happy to remove this mod forever.

In the meantime, I'll take all the endorsements I can get! (That was a joke. This is a silly little nothing mod. It does not deserve your endorsement. Others deserve endorsements far more - particularly the two mods it is creating compatibility for. PLEASE go and endorse them if you like this one. :)

---
